en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large stone church with a tall clock tower and slender spire reflected in a pond in the foreground. The building has neo‑Gothic / neo‑Romanesque features, arched windows, a steep slate roof, and an ornate entrance. Trees and a low fence stand between the church and the water; low hills are visible in the distant background. The corners of the print are cut, emphasizing its postcard or plate format. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the front.
